_doc: SYSTM Depth art bible. Every Codex image prompt = base + world.look + role rule + the layer's own prompt. Change the look here, not in plans. looks: כל סרטון בוחר look אחר (plan.look); signature: מה שקבוע בכולם.
base: Cinematic film still, photoreal, shot on ARRI Alexa 35, 35mm lens, Kodak Vision3 500T grade, fine film grain, soft halation. Low-key lighting: deep carbon-black shadows (#080c0e) that keep detail, one soft warm-neutral key light, and exactly ONE cool ice-cyan accent light (#acf4f8). Restrained palette: carbon black, graphite, warm off-white paper (#f5f7f7), ice cyan; everything desaturated except skin and the ice accent. Materials: matte off-white ceramic with soft rounded clay-like forms, frosted glass, brushed graphite metal, paper. Premium, quiet, editorial. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no people unless asked.

roles.bg: A full-bleed background plate for a vertical 9:16 video. Deep perspective that recedes far into the distance so a camera can travel into it. Keep the CENTER and UPPER-MIDDLE of the frame calm and empty (a floating object and a title will be composited there later). Nothing touching the camera.
roles.mid: A single isolated set piece. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with a real alpha channel (PNG). The piece alone, nothing else in the frame, no floor, no backdrop, no cast-shadow plane, fully inside the frame with a margin on every side.
roles.hero: One single hero object, the star of the shot, beautifully lit as a premium product shot. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with a real alpha channel (PNG). The object alone, nothing else, no floor, no backdrop, no cast-shadow plane, fully inside the frame with a margin on every side.
roles.card: One flat physical card, sheet of paper, phone or screen, seen straight-on or slightly angled. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with a real alpha channel (PNG). The item alone, fully inside the frame with a margin on every side. Any text on it must be exactly the text given, otherwise blank.
roles.fg: A loose foreground element (floating paper sheets, dust motes, glass shards or similar) that will sit very close to the camera and be out of focus. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with a real alpha channel (PNG). Nothing else in the frame.
roles.actor: A single small isolated object on a transparent background, crisp, studio lit, no shadow on the ground.

worlds.gallery: A dark minimalist museum hall: polished black concrete floor with soft reflections, tall graphite walls, low warm pools of light, a thin ice-cyan light strip far in the distance.
worlds.studio: A dark editorial studio at night: matte graphite desk surfaces, one warm brass desk lamp, a monitor casting a faint ice-cyan glow, deep shadows, light haze.
worlds.archive: A dark archive corridor of graphite metal shelves and off-white paper files receding into deep perspective, light haze, an ice-cyan light at the far end.
worlds.void: An infinite carbon-black void with a glossy black floor, soft volumetric haze, a single ice-cyan light from above forming a pool on the floor.
worlds.lab: A dark brutalist lab of raw concrete and frosted glass panels, cool haze, ice-cyan practical lights set into the walls, warm light on the work surfaces.
worlds.city: A night city seen from a high window at blue hour, dark and quiet, warm windows, ice-cyan signal lights, haze over the streets.

signature._doc: מה שלא משתנה אף פעם, בכל look: אלה סימני הזיהוי של SYSTM. הם חייבים להופיע בכל סרטון.
signature.accent: Ice #acf4f8 הוא צבע הדגש היחיד, בכל שכבה, כותרת וכתובית.
signature.font: SYSTM Display V2 (הגופן שלנו, לא זמין לאחרים) לכל טקסט.
signature.line: מעבר הקו (transition: line) לפחות פעם אחת, עם צליל החתימה.
signature.sound: צליל החתימה של SYSTM (sound/sfx/signature) על הקו ובסוף כל סרטון.
signature.hallmark: אובייקט החתימה: מונולית קרמיקה אוף-וייט קטן עם תפר Ice דק, מופיע בכל סרטון באחת הפעימות (prompt: 'the SYSTM hallmark: a small matte off-white ceramic monolith with a single thin glowing ice-cyan seam').
signature.grain: גרעין קולנועי וצללים קרירים בכל גרייד.
